content:
This is a wooden Kagura mask, "Ko-Tengu," featuring a powerful expression and the rich texture of deep red lacquer.

The long beard and strong form give it the unique presence characteristic of Kagura and Tengu masks, making it a striking piece not only for stage performances but also for interior decoration, warding off evil, and as a good luck charm.

The depth of the carving, unique to wood sculpture, combined with the aged texture of the lacquer, creates an antique aesthetic that cannot be found in mass-produced items.

Highly recommended for those who appreciate Kagura, Noh, folk performing arts, antique tools, and collectibles.

*Note: There is a crack (please refer to the photos).
